name: print-social-teal-hanging-qr-tag-launch-key-visual
title: Hanging QR Tag Launch Visual
whatItIs: A teal scene with a white rounded tag hanging from a bright green coiled cord, printing 'Scan to register' over a QR code, with an angled flyer in the corner and light rays.
whatItMeans: The dangling tag makes a QR call to action feel physical and inviting. Green and teal feel fresh.
techniques: Physical prop (tag on a cord) carrying the call to action
Bright green cord as the only vivid accent
Light beams through a teal atmosphere
Cropped flyer at the edge for context
Big rounded shape with a tiny label for simplicity

vocabulary.definition: A physical-looking object that carries the ask.
Diagonal beams of light adding atmosphere.
A printed piece partly shown to suggest a wider campaign.
